questions.question: Discuss the fundamentals of bond markets. Explain bond pricing mechanisms, bond yield calculations, and the inverse relationship between market interest rates and bond prices. Describe the various types of bonds available in the Indian bond market.
questions.solution_html:
• Coupon Rate: The fixed annual interest rate paid by the bond issuer, calculated as a
  • percentage of the bond’s face (par) value. It remains constant throughout the bond’s
  • life. Market Interest Rate: The prevailing rate of return demanded by investors for
  • similar bonds in the open market. It fluctuates based on economic conditions
  • inflation, and central bank policies.
